## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: 7001680dd3f527e118a3fe7d77b1f43d6450b8ea · read 2026-11-21T11:24Z · 6 files +737/−14 · checks at this head: 41 success · 15 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending · mergeable clean, merges clean onto main 8145424b (#36037 already in) · l1-face CLEAN

**维护者速读：** 管理员给共享视图存草稿（比如选底部合计方式、改视图设置）后，列表不再闪一下跳回已发布版本，连续改两次也会叠加，不会第二次覆盖第一次。做法是：刷新元数据时，已经拿到过的答复继续算"有答复"，页面不回骨架屏、不重挂；有应用包的应用同理，用上一次的包内视图撑着，等新包下载完。这对所有刷新信号都生效（发布、装包、别的标签页改动），是"先显示旧的、后台换新的"，不改变刷新约定。非管理员仍只看到发布后的视图。没有阻塞问题，两条小建议见下。

### Must-fix
None.

### Should-fix
None.

### Nits

- **N1 — the last-answered bundle is not tied to its app.** `answeredBundleRef` (`MetadataProvider.tsx:1109`, set at :1157) holds the last `ready` bundle of any app. `AppBundleStore.peek()` answers `pending` for a first entry into another app too (`checkedAt === 0`), so entering app X for the first time, with every asked object also in app Y's bundle, now settles on Y's views where it used to wait. Today that is harmless. The server puts every view bound to a served object in a bundle (`meta-app-bundle-routes.ts:300-303`), so a shared object carries the same views in both. But the comment and the changeset describe it as "a reload after a refresh pulse". Either key the held items by the app that answered them, or say in the comment that a first entry into another app takes the same path.
- **N2 — worth one browser look: Create view while in draft preview.** Create announces the pulse and navigates to the new draft view. With the route kept mounted, `resolvedViewId` misses until `listViews` (refreshKey) or the in-place `/meta/view` refetch lands. That may show one frame of the default view plus the `Requested view … not found` warning, where the old path showed the skeleton. I have not run this. If it shows, it is a flash, not wrong data.

### Checked

- `answered` is set on a settled fetch (ready or error) and on the cached app item, and cleared only by a whole-type `invalidate`. `refresh()` and a lapsed TTL go through `ensureType`, which sets `loading` but keeps the items, so `typeAnswered` treats a refetch in place as answered. An error answer that is being retried stays settled, as `error` already did.
- `viewsForObjects`: with the bundle `ready`, the code reads as before. With it `pending`, it falls back to the last-answered items only when they hold every asked object, and otherwise waits as before. The listed merge takes a list that is refetching in place. The no-bundle path settles on the held list. The unscoped object path's `settled` uses the same rule. Preview has `peekBundle` null, so it never reads the held bundle. `dropAdapterWorld` (organization or session switch) forgets it.
- `handleDraftBarChange`: Publish or Discard sets the flag and bumps `refreshKey`. The effect drops `viewDraft` on the next `savedViews` change, which the `listViews` effect always produces, including on its `catch` (`setSavedViews([])`) and on the no-adapter branch. So the flag cannot go stale and later drop a draft being edited.
- Tests: list path (no skeleton, no remount, two picks stack, reader sees the published view, CONTROL: `invalidate('view')` still waits). Bundle path (one mount through the reload, two picks then Publish, CONTROL: a first entry with no answered bundle waits, CONTROL: `invalidate('object')` shows the skeleton). Draft-bar handler unit test. The browser reading, 4 items with screenshots, is the thread's, not repeated here.
- Shape: draft, `Fixes #35932` (the card's whole ask: the list keeps the draft, and a second change builds on the first), one changeset `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. The changeset states the side effect (every pulse keeps the drawn route).

### Owed

- L1 final at this head. To the seat for landing. N1 and N2 are the author's call, and neither blocks.

Seat landing · 2026-11-21T11:25Z · The b1-DB area's PR for #35932: saving a list draft or publishing it no longer flashes the app skeleton or remounts the list. `MetadataProvider` changes only on the read side: it remembers the last answered app bundle of this world (cleared on an organisation or session change), and while the bundle reloads, `viewsForObjects` treats that answer as settled when it covers every object asked. The refresh contract (`clearCache`, the pulse, `peekAppBundle`'s return) is unchanged. Side effect, stated in the body: during a reload the route shows the previous bundle's views, and the draft overlay keeps the draft on screen. The browser re-read on round 2 passed all four items, with both controls still distinguishing (`invalidate('object')` still remounts once; a first open still waits for the loading screen). `Clause-②: no`, no L2 owed. L1-b ACCEPT 7061871544 on `7001680d` (this head). `check-governed-merges --pr 36031` reads NOT governed (+737/−14). `landing-k` was not needed: the seat read K by hand, 9 since the merge base, under 15, and main since then touches neither `translations/` nor `skills/`. On this head, 41 check-runs are success, 15 are skipped and none failed; mergeable clean. Two nits stay unfixed: the remembered bundle is not keyed by app (harmless today, as one object's views are the same in every bundle), and creating a view during a draft preview may flash the default view for a frame (not measured). #36037 resolves its one-line conflict in `ObjectView.tsx` when it merges main. The seat readies this PR and arms auto-merge in the same step. The PR carries `Fixes #35932`.
